@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+"""Fixture argument diagnostics for plugins."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+
+from _pytest.compat import getfuncargnames
+
+
+def fixture_contract(
+    function: Callable[..., object], cls: type | None = None
+) -> dict[str, str | list[str]]:
+    """Return the function name and ordered names of its required fixture arguments."""
+    required = getfuncargnames(function, cls=cls, raise_on_invalid_signature=True)
+    return {"name": function.__name__, "required": list(required)}

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from _pytest.fixture_contract import fixture_contract
+import pytest
+
+
+def test_fixture_contract_arguments() -> None:
+    def example(
+        positional: object,
+        /,
+        first: object,
+        optional: object = None,
+        *args: object,
+        second: object,
+        optional_keyword: object = None,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    assert fixture_contract(example) == {
+        "name": "example",
+        "required": ["first", "second"],
+    }
+
+
+def test_fixture_contract_methods() -> None:
+    class Example:
+        def method(self, fixture: object) -> None:
+            pass
+
+        @staticmethod
+        def static(fixture: object) -> None:
+            pass
+
+    class Renamed:
+        alias = staticmethod(Example.static)
+
+    assert fixture_contract(Example.method, Example) == {
+        "name": "method",
+        "required": ["fixture"],
+    }
+    assert fixture_contract(Example().method, Example) == {
+        "name": "method",
+        "required": ["fixture"],
+    }
+    assert fixture_contract(Example.static, Example) == {
+        "name": "static",
+        "required": ["fixture"],
+    }
+    assert fixture_contract(Renamed.alias, Renamed) == {
+        "name": "static",
+        "required": ["fixture"],
+    }
+
+
+def test_fixture_contract_mocks() -> None:
+    @patch("os.getcwd")
+    def patched(mocked: object, /, fixture: object, *, keyword: object) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    assert fixture_contract(patched) == {
+        "name": "patched",
+        "required": ["fixture", "keyword"],
+    }
+
+
+def test_fixture_contract_invalid_signature() -> None:
+    function = test_fixture_contract_invalid_signature
+    with patch.object(function, "__signature__", object(), create=True):
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="__signature__"):
+            fixture_contract(function)
+
+    with patch.object(function, "__wrapped__", function, create=True):
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="wrapper loop"):
+            fixture_contract(function)

notes:
fixture_contract wraps _pytest.compat.getfuncargnames, extended with a raise_on_invalid_signature flag so signature errors propagate, and with index-based skipping so bound-method receivers and mock-injected args are dropped correctly even when they are positional-only (static methods, including aliased ones, keep their parameters). It returns function.__name__ plus the ordered required list.
